faq_heading: Glenwood condos and townhomes: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Glenwood. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Glenwood, Port Coquitlam: 41 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September 2026 and 7 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 17%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 2 of 10 Port Coquitlam communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Port Coquitlam total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Glenwood fell from 42 in June to 41 in September (−2.4%), and 26 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 18.3% of Port Coquitlam’s 224 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Glenwood?
Glenwood also had 39 houses listed and 1 sold in September, against 41 condos and townhomes listed. The Glenwood houses page has those figures.

blocks.text: Glenwood home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

45 condos sold in Glenwood with a median price of $512,000 (the middle half sold between $426,000 and $580,000), taking a median of 36 days to sell at 97.1% of the last list price; 4% sold above list. They had a median $576 per square foot, a median year built of 1996 and a median strata fee of $408 a month. 19 townhomes sold in Glenwood with a median price of $765,000 (the middle half sold between $673,000 and $930,000), taking a median of 21 days to sell at 97.2% of the last list price; 5% sold above list. They had a median $551 per square foot, a median year built of 2006 and a median strata fee of $415 a month.

blocks.text: Condo buildings in Glenwood PQ
Glenwood is a board (MLS) sub-area of the City of Port Coquitlam, not a City neighbourhood in the Official Community Plan.
The Arden — 1990 Westminster Avenue (Glenwood PQ)

A boutique apartment-condo building by Fairwind Homes, completed in fall 2018 (developer source); strata plan EPS5130, built 2018, sub-area Glenwood PQ per the building directory's property records, and current listings record the form as Apartment/Condo in this sub-area. Unit count UNCONFIRMED between sources: the developer source and listing copy state 22 units ("just 22 EXECUTIVE Suites"), while the directory's unit page describes the address as 16 units — do not quote either figure without the strata plan. Listing copy markets it to "First Timers, Down-sizers and Investors" with rentals and pets allowed, and no source states any age restriction — general-market, verified NOT 55+.
The Sapphire — 1969 Westminster Avenue (Glenwood PQ)

The condo strata for Strata Plan BCS3110, managed by Quay Pacific Property Management (manager's AGM document); built 2008, and current listings record units as Apartment/Condo in Glenwood PQ, with a current listing recording pets as cats OK. Unit count: UNCONFIRMED. Dog policy and any age restriction: no source states either — age restriction UNCONFIRMED / not verified as 55+.
Portica West — 1966 Coquitlam Avenue (Glenwood PQ)

An apartment-condo building built in 1993, 50 units (building directory; an MLS sheet for the complex likewise records "Units in Dev: 50" and Strata Plan LMS916), freehold strata. The directory records its strata restrictions as: pets allowed with restrictions, rentals allowed with restrictions — the rental-restriction element of that line is VOID since November 24, 2022. Directory amenities: elevator, in-suite laundry, sauna/steam room; listing amenities add a clubhouse and exercise/recreation centre.
Lexford by Polygon — 2178 Prairie Avenue (Glenwood PQ)

A new apartment-condo building by Polygon (Polygon Lexford Homes Ltd.): current MLS listings record units at this address as Apartment/Condo, freehold strata, built 2026, in the Glenwood PQ sub-area, with over 7,000 sq ft of onsite amenities per the developer (fitness room, yoga studio, lounge, study lounges, bike wash, kids' play area, lawn space, community garden). Total unit count: UNCONFIRMED (listings show units for sale, not a building total). Pet rule: a current listing records cats OK; the full pet bylaw is UNCONFIRMED. Any unit still on a developer contract carries the REDMA frame in and 5% GST.
Streets, schools and getting around Glenwood PQ

items.t: Glenwood is a residential sub-area on Port Coquitlam's north side, around Glen Elementary School at 3064 Glen Drive. It is the sub-area name as the board (GVR) uses it in the SnapStats GVR September 2026 report; Glenwood is not named as an established neighbourhood in the City's Official Community Plan — it sits inside the City's north-side residential area — and its boundary roads are UNVERIFIED, because no City neighbourhood map defining Glenwood's boundaries was found on an official source.

Where condo stock concentrates: two small pockets, both verified by name in — the Westminster Avenue pair (The Arden at 1990, The Sapphire at 1969) and Portica West at 1966 Coquitlam Avenue in the sub-area's west end, plus the new Lexford apartment building at 2178 Prairie Avenue on the Prairie Avenue corridor, where townhouse complexes (Shaughnessy Park, Westmount Park) also sit. Lougheed Highway runs along the south side of north Port Coquitlam below Glenwood; Coast Meridian Road and Lincoln Avenue are the north–south routes.

Schools: Glen Elementary (3064 Glen Dr) is the school inside the sub-area; an SD43 School Locator run for that address returned Glen Elementary, École Maple Creek Middle and Pinetree Secondary. Catchments are address-based — confirm any specific address in the locator.

Transit and recreation: TransLink buses connect north Port Coquitlam with Coquitlam Central Station (Millennium Line Evergreen Extension and West Coast Express) and Port Coquitlam Station (West Coast Express); specific route numbers through Glenwood are UNVERIFIED. Hyde Creek Recreation Centre at 1379 Laurier Avenue is the north-side recreation centre; Evergreen Park at 3500 Cedar Drive is listed in the City Parks Directory on the north side.

blocks.text: Good to know about Glenwood PQ

items.t: Glenwood is a board name, not a city neighbourhood. The City's Official Community Plan does not name Glenwood as an established neighbourhood at all — it sits inside the north-side residential area — so a buyer searching City documents for "Glenwood" boundaries will find nothing; the sub-area exists in MLS and SnapStats geography only, and its boundary roads are UNVERIFIED on any official source.

The Arden's unit count disagrees with itself in public sources. The developer source and listing copy say 22 suites; the building directory's unit page describes the address as 16 units. The strata plan (EPS5130) settles it — pull it before quoting a per-unit figure for fees, parking or voting weight.

Two of this sub-area's condo addresses sit within a few doors of each other and are easy to confuse. The Arden (1990 Westminster Ave, 2018) and The Sapphire (1969 Westminster Ave, 2008, BCS3110) are separate stratas a decade apart in age — depreciation reports, CRF balances and bylaws are building-specific; do not carry one building's documents into the other building's deal.
Glenwood's attached shelf is quietly newer than its detached shelf. SnapStats GVR September 2026 report.

Port Coquitlam bills utilities flat, not metered. Water and sewer are flat annual fees billed separately from property taxes, due March 31 — a simpler cost line to budget than metered billing elsewhere.

Streets, schools and getting around Glenwood PQ

items.t: Glenwood PQ is a Port Coquitlam neighbourhood in the city's north-central area; it is named for the "Glenn/Glenwood" elements in the City of Port Coquitlam's own neighbourhood profile — boundaries for the profile neighbourhood are not stated in the profile text itself, and the profile's "Glenwood" name is a neighbourhood-planning convenience rather than a City OCP neighbourhood designation: the City OCP (Bylaw No. 3838) names "Glenwood" nowhere as a formal neighbourhood. The board and SnapStats sub-area name as used by Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and SnapStats is Glenwood PQ.
Schools: SD43 serves Port Coquitlam. Every other Glenwood PQ catchment is UNVERIFIED per address; do not infer a catchment from the schools physically inside the sub-area.
Maillardville sits across the municipal boundary in Coquitlam as the oldest francophone community in B.C. (a retail/cultural amenity, not PoCo jurisdiction).
Hospital: Eagle Ridge Hospital, 475 Guildford Way, Port Moody — the City of Port Coquitlam has no hospital within its boundaries; Eagle Ridge is the serving acute hospital.

Rail and transit: West Coast Express runs through Port Coquitlam Station — five trains toward Waterfront (Vancouver) in the morning peak and five returning in the evening peak, weekdays only, no weekend or statutory holiday service; no West Coast Express station in any other PoCo neighbourhood.

Flood frame: much of Port Coquitlam lies in the Fraser River and Pitt River floodplain behind dykes; the City's flood strategy runs through its OCP Hazard Lands DPA and the Fraser Basin Council's Lower Mainland Flood Management Strategy. Glenwood-specific lot-level flood status is UNVERIFIED — do not quote a Glenwood-specific flood figure from any single address or listing.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Glenwood PQ

items.t: Form B diligence (the counted strata and the cross-referenced one): Strata Property Act s. 59 — the Form B states the lot's monthly strata fees, amounts owing, approved special levies still payable, the CRF balance and an insurance summary, with the rules, current budget, any Rental Disclosure Statement and the most recent depreciation report attached; provided within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page.
City of Port Coquitlam taxes and utilities: Strata units carry their own arrangements for some services — confirm on the Form B.

blocks.text: Good to know about Glenwood PQ

items.t: "Glenwood" is a stats name, not a city neighbourhood. The City OCP (Bylaw No. 3838) never designates "Glenwood" as a neighbourhood, and the City's own profile boundaries are not stated in its profile text — the name lives in the board/SnapStats sub-area system. Practical consequence: zoning, permits and catchment questions are answered lot-by-lot from Bylaw 3630 and SD43, never from the sub-area label.
The sub-area's stats hide the townhouses inside a combined bucket. The community attached median ($660,000) is the only honest attached figure to quote.
Two of this sub-area's complexes answer to the same developer name in different programs.
PoCo's entire 55+ ownership market is one apartment building with a service contract.

The West Coast Express is a weekday-only, peak-only service. Five trains each direction, no weekend or holiday service — a Glenwood townhouse bought for a downtown commute works on that schedule or not at all, and the SkyTrain business case changes nothing on any published timeline.
Shaughnessy Park's age is genuinely unsettled in the public record.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Glenwood?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 41 condos and townhomes listed in Glenwood. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Glenwood a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Glenwood had a sales ratio of 17%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Glenwood from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 26 condos and townhomes sold in Glenwood over those 4 months, out of 151 in all of Port Coquitlam.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did condos in Glenwood sell for?
faq.a: 45 condos sold in Glenwood between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $512,000.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in Glenwood?
faq.a: The median was 36 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.1% of the last list price (4% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: How did Glenwood sell in September 2026?
Is Shaughnessy Park a condo building?
faq.a: No — it is a 32-home townhouse complex at 3655 Shaughnessy St: 3–4 bedroom family townhomes, pets allowed with restrictions, no age restriction, and a build year that conflicts between sources (1982 vs 1983, UNCONFIRMED).

faq.q: Can I rent out a Glenwood condo long-term?
faq.a: Yes — strata rental-restriction bylaws have been void since November 24, 2022 anywhere in BC, including the restriction element in Portica West's directory line. A strata can still restrict short-term rentals by bylaw.

faq.q: What is Village Green at 2183 Prairie Avenue — apartments or townhouses?
Shaughnessy Park's directory line says "rentals allowed with restrictions." Can I actually rent my unit out?
faq.a: Yes, long-term — that restriction element has been void province-wide since November 24, 2022. The pets element of the same published line (pets allowed with restrictions) stands as published. Short-term rentals are a separate bylaw question — confirm on the Form B.
UNCONFIRMED — one current listing records 1982; a building directory and other listings record 1983.

faq.q: Is there a 55+ townhouse in Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: No verified one anywhere in the city. PoCo's only verified 55+ ownership complex is Mayfair Terrace (2266 Atkins Ave) — an apartment-form strata with a mandatory Aspira service plan ($715/mo first resident / $400 second, listing-stated) — and its other 55+ name, Kew Lifestyles at Montrose, is rental. Neither counted townhouse complex here carries any age restriction.
